_about: User-facing line per BACKLOG/CHANGELOG Log item, for recipefinder.uk/whats-new.html (tools/website-whats-new.py). Items not listed here are left off the page; the script prints them so you can add copy.
Web search redesign: Search the web feels like a browser: an address bar, back and forward, suggestions and your recent searches, with an Import button whenever a page holds a recipe.
Import PDFs and multi-page photos: Import recipes from PDFs, or from up to five photos of a cookbook spread, read in the order you pick them.
Import from other apps: Bring your recipes over from Paprika, Mela or a CSV file — photos come too, and recipes you already have are skipped.
Estimate missing amounts: Recipes that are missing amounts can get suggested ones from Apple Intelligence on your device, for you to review and edit.
\"Made it\" moment: Tap Made it to see your cook count, streak and stars, add a photo and find out how close your next badge is.
Refresh stale bundled recipes: Built-in recipes get tidied steps and ingredients, with your favourites, ratings, photos and edits kept.
Bundled-recipe gaps (interactive): Built-in recipes now show amounts and prep and cook times where they used to be blank.
Missing-amount display (interactive): Ingredients without amounts read cleanly, with a quick way to add your own.
🐞 Nightly UI test red (Made it): Your first cook now shows the Made it sheet and then your Head Chef badge, one after the other.
Import 1/5 slice 4: Re-import a pasted, photographed or shared recipe from its original text and review the changes before saving.
Import 2/5 done: When an import is hard to read, the review screen points out the parts to check.
Manual 1/3 wizard bugs (interactive): Creating a recipe by hand is smoother: amounts like ½ or 1,5 are understood and your edits are kept safe if you swipe away.
Manual 2/3 slice 2: Type or paste ingredients and steps one per line when creating a recipe, with a live preview as you go.
Manual 3/3 slice 1: Set prep and cook times in hours and minutes, and servings up to 50.
Manual 3/3 slice 2: Recipe photos are easier to manage, with bigger, clearly labelled remove buttons.
🐞 🔴 Photo overwrite after delete: Recipe photos stay put when you delete one and add another.
🐞 🔴 Restore slice 1: Restoring a backup brings back your cooks, favourites, ratings, tags and edits to built-in recipes.
🐞 🔴 Restore slice 2: Backups now include your cooking streak.
🐞 🟠 Add amount button: Ingredients without an amount show an Add amount button.
🐞 🟠 Star rating accessibility: Star ratings work smoothly with VoiceOver and grow with your text size.
🐞 Servings + catalog gaps: Refreshing or re-importing a recipe keeps the servings you chose.
Import 3/5 slice 1: If pasted text isn't a recipe yet, start a new recipe from it in one tap.
Import 3/5 slice 2: When a link or photo can't be read, you can start from the text or paste the recipe instead.
